episode.tagline: Ideas can often be an engine to think about the world. Seeing Like a State by James C Scott is a great book that has illuminated the world with the power of its frameworks — and both Amit and Ajay are fans.
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay talks about what Scott’s book meant to him — and lays out an easy introduction to its powerful ideas.
